name: biotin transmembrane transporter activity
description: "Enables the transfer of biotin from one side of a membrane to the other. Biotin is cis-tetrahydro-2-oxothieno(3,4-d)imidazoline-4-valeric acid; the (+) enantiomer is very widely distributed in cells and serves as a carrier in a number of enzymatic beta-carboxylation reactions." [GOC:ai]

name: oxidoreductase activity, acting on paired donors, with incorporation or reduction of molecular oxygen, NAD(P)H as one donor, and incorporation of one atom of oxygen
description: "Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction in which hydrogen or electrons are transferred from NADH or NADPH and one other donor, and one atom of oxygen is incorporated into one donor." [EC:1.14.13.-]

name: benzaldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
description: "Catalysis of the reaction: benzaldehyde + NAD+ + H2O = benzoate + NADH + H+." [EC:1.2.1.28]

name: flavonol 3-O-arabinosyltransferase activity
description: "Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-arabinose + a flavonol = UDP + a flavonol 3-O-D-arabinoside." [PMID:18757557]

name: indole-3-carbonyl nitrile 4-hydroxylase activity
description: "Catalysis of the reaction: indole-3-carbonyl nitrile + NADPH +O2=4-hydroxyindole-3- carbonyl nitrile + NADP+ + H20." [GOC:lr, PMID:26352477, RHEA:57864]

name: scopoletin 8-hydroxylase activity
description: "Catalyzes of the reaction: scopoletin + 2-oxoglutarate+O2=fraxetin +succinate+ CO2)." [GOC:lr, PMID:29361149, PMID:29581584, RHEA:57848]

name: arabinosyltransferase activity
description: "Catalysis of the transfer of an arabinosyl group from one compound (donor) to another (acceptor)." [GOC:ai]

name: aldehyde oxidase activity
description: "Catalysis of the reaction: an aldehyde + H2O + O2 = a carboxylic acid + hydrogen peroxide." [EC:1.2.3.1]

name: aryl-aldehyde oxidase activity
description: "Catalysis of the reaction: an aromatic aldehyde + O2 + H2O = an aromatic acid + hydrogen peroxide." [EC:1.2.3.9]

name: oxidoreductase activity, acting on the aldehyde or oxo group of donors, oxygen as acceptor
description: "Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction in which an aldehyde or ketone (oxo) group acts as a hydrogen or electron donor and reduces oxygen." [EC:1.2.3.-]

name: monooxygenase activity
description: "Catalysis of the incorporation of one atom of molecular oxygen (O2) into the substrate and the reduction of the other atom of O2 to water." [PMID:1444267]

name: phospholipase activator activity
description: "Binds to and increases the activity of a phospholipase, an enzyme that catalyzes of the hydrolysis of a glycerophospholipid." [GOC:ai]

name: lipase activator activity
description: "Binds to and increases the activity of a lipase, an enzyme that catalyzes of the hydrolysis of a lipid." [GOC:BHF, GOC:dph, GOC:tb]

name: alpha-L-arabinofuranosidase activity
description: "Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing alpha-L-arabinofuranoside residues in alpha-L-arabinosides." [EC:3.2.1.55, GOC:mf]

name: vitamin transmembrane transporter activity
description: "Enables the transfer of a vitamin from one side of a membrane to the other." [GOC:tb]

name: glycerol-3-phosphate 2-O-acyltransferase activity
description: "Catalysis of the reaction: an acyl-CoA + sn-glycerol 3-phosphate = CoA + a 2-acyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate." [RHEA:33559]
